test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29e87c0bb887070d66a24ce71044b04a80d828ef5ca79727f6ac594657c263ea.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**From figure 1 to 3 and figure 3 to 5:**

 
• All symbols inside circle are shifting in clockwise direction.

**From figure 2 to figure 4:**

 
• All symbols inside circle are shifting in anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/084a89447dc58788aac3df1770da1b237ecdb0b3c9852cb6f34ef176461fd030.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
